notes: Binary: scratchpad/langs/repocortex; each language indexed in its own empty directory under scratchpad/langs/work/G1/<language>; raw query output in work/G1/out/<language>.{files,syms}.json.

Precision is null where nothing was extracted. Where the tool extracted anything, precision was 1.0 in every language: 180 extracted symbols across the group, 0 wrong (no calls, references, keywords or duplicates recorded as definitions).
Totals over the 12 languages: expected 807, extracted 180, correct 180, missed 627 (authzed alone contributes 414 expected; without it 393 expected, 213 missed).

Root cause of the zero/low-recall languages: gotreesitter ships no per-language tags queries; the query is inferred from a fixed list of generic node names (function_definition, function_declaration, class_declaration, method_declaration, function_item, struct_item, enum_item, trait_item ...). RepoCortex adds supplements only for go, java, typescript, tsx, javascript, python, rust, cpp, c_sharp, ruby (internal/parse/queries.go), none for this group. A grammar is reported as having a tags query ('ok' in tags_probe.tsv) as soon as one generic pattern compiles, even if the language's real declaration nodes (bicep param/resource, circom template, capnp struct, authzed definition, cairo impl/mod, clojure deftype/ns) match nothing.

parse_status is not a signal of extraction quality: bicep files and circom/comparators.circom are 'ok' with 0 symbols; authzed and capnp are 'partial' on every file including minimal valid input; parse_error is always empty for 'partial'.

Detection findings: angular grammar unreachable (no extension); no shebang detection (extensionless bash script skipped); BitBake .inc -> pascal; Babashka .bb -> bitbake; .cljs.hl and .pacscript -> no grammar; Cairo Zero and Cairo 1 share .cairo.

Nothing crashed or hung. Slowest runs: authzed 1038 ms for 5 files / 645 lines and capnp 533 ms for 5 files / 503 lines (both the all-'partial' languages; multival_schema.zed and oviva.zed dominate), against 30-240 ms for every other language.

Kind notes: struct and enum become 'class' by the tool's own kind model (kindFromTag), counted as sensible; Cairo traits as 'class' counted as wrong kind (2); Apex constructors as 'method', CMake macros and Cairo impl methods as 'function' counted as sensible.
